# Contribution

Have a great example of a process template, project template or policy you want to share?  Here is how to share it with the world!

## Licensing

This project is covered by the [MIT License](https://github.com/BobJWalker/Trident/blob/main/LICENSE). [This site](https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/) provides a good explanation of what this license provides for you as a contributor. By contributing to this library:

* Your contribution is automatically covered by [MIT License](https://github.com/BobJWalker/Trident/blob/main/LICENSE). [This site](https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/) without requiring a header in each file.
* Your contribution is attributed to you (and your organization) via commits and pull-requests.
* State changes are tracked automatically via commits and pull-requests.

## Guidelines

If you would like to contribute, please follow these guidelines:

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bug fix.
3. Make your changes and commit them.
4. Push your changes to your forked repository.
5. Submit a pull request.
